nodes.label: App
nodes.desc: EventDispatcher subclass; App.run() wraps runTouchApp with on_start/on_stop

nodes.label: runTouchApp()
nodes.desc: Prepares a window, adds the root widget, then starts the loop

nodes.label: EventLoopBase
nodes.desc: Module-level singleton EventLoop (L487); holds providers, postproc and listeners

nodes.label: EventDispatcher
nodes.desc: Cython base class with uid counter, bind()/unbind() and dispatch()

nodes.label: Property
nodes.desc: Cython Property with Numeric, String, Alias, Color and more subclasses; dispatch() runs observers

nodes.label: idle()
nodes.desc: One frame: Clock.tick, dispatch_input, Builder.sync, tick_draw, on_draw, on_flip

nodes.label: ClockBase
nodes.desc: Interrupt behaviors layered on CyClockBase; _max_fps read from Config

nodes.label: CyClockBase
nodes.desc: Cython timing core that runs clock events per frame

nodes.label: MotionEventFactory
nodes.desc: register()/get() name-to-class registry for input providers

nodes.label: MotionEventProvider
nodes.desc: Abstract provider: start()/stop(); update() is polled by the loop

nodes.label: MotionEvent
nodes.desc: Touch abstraction: depack, push/pop transforms, grab()/release

nodes.label: MouseMotionEventProvider
nodes.desc: Desktop mouse provider producing MouseMotionEvent(MotionEvent)

nodes.label: dispatch_input()
nodes.desc: provider.update() gathers events, postproc modules process them, then real dispatch

nodes.label: post_dispatch_input()
nodes.desc: on_motion to all listeners; grabbed widgets get transformed on_touch_move/up

nodes.label: WindowBase
nodes.desc: EventDispatcher window: on_draw (L1753), on_flip (L1590), create_window (L1534)

nodes.label: on_touch_down
nodes.desc: Iterates children, dispatches until a widget consumes the touch

nodes.label: Widget
nodes.desc: Canvas owner; to_local/to_window, collide_point, add_widget/remove_widget

nodes.label: walk()
nodes.desc: Generator visiting the tree in forward layout order, with restrict/loopback

nodes.label: Layout
nodes.desc: Adds the do_layout() contract re-run on size/pos changes

nodes.label: BoxLayout
nodes.desc: do_layout() distributes children along horizontal/vertical orientation

nodes.label: ScrollView
nodes.desc: Largest UI module; StencilView subclass with scroll effects on the clock

nodes.label: Instruction
nodes.desc: Cython base with GI_* flag bits from opcodes.pxi

nodes.label: InstructionGroup
nodes.desc: Ordered instruction list compiled and applied as one unit

nodes.label: Canvas
nodes.desc: CanvasBase subclass every widget owns as .canvas

nodes.label: RenderContext
nodes.desc: Canvas + default Shader (L811); self.compiler = GraphicsCompiler() at L172

nodes.label: GraphicsCompiler
nodes.desc: compile() tracks context state per RenderContext and sets GI_IGNORE to skip no-op applies

nodes.label: Context
nodes.desc: Global registry of textures, shaders and batches; supports reload on GL restart

nodes.label: Rectangle
nodes.desc: VertexInstruction producing textured quads; Ellipse extends it

nodes.label: Line
nodes.desc: Polyline instruction; triangulates thick segments for the vertex batch

nodes.label: Tesselator
nodes.desc: Polygon triangulation via add_contour; feeds complex shapes

nodes.label: VertexBatch
nodes.desc: Indexed vertex batch over a VBO; the draw unit for instructions

nodes.label: Shader
nodes.desc: Vertex/fragment program holder with uniform state

nodes.label: LabelBase
nodes.desc: Text rendering contract implemented by SDL3, Pango and PIL backends

nodes.label: WindowSDL
nodes.desc: SDL3 window provider; also ships SDL3MotionEventProvider (L118)
